name: ModelVariant845_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant845_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (once the start time passes two bolts leave a model point and fly towards jittered points on the opposing slot, wrapped in rings of sprites and spinning Gouraud strips and trailing ribbons and smoke puffs; on arrival each flares into a glow with two fans of rays, animated sparks and a growing shock ring while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the bolts and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 1 once when the first bolt arrives, 2 once the ambient light has recovered and the glow has faded and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-862 and 959 images build it from the same source with the US layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
